page_title: MON 2-0 BRE | Monaco v Brest 05/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
90+2' Eric Wattellier blows his whistle and Lilian Brassier (Brest) is shown a second yellow card for his foul. His manager will not be pleased. He has lot of time to think about it as he walks off.
90+2' A fine pass finds Myron Boadu (Monaco) in space inside the box, he looks up and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Marco Bizot reacts superbly to deny him.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' The substitution is prepared. Myron Boadu (Monaco) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Aleksandr Golovin.
89' Adi Hutter has decided to substitute Youssouf Fofana and he is replaced by Mohamed Camara (Monaco).
88' Eric Wattellier shows a yellow card to Youssouf Fofana (Monaco) for a tough tackle.
87' Monaco failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
83' That will be all from Hugo Magnetti who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest).
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Bilal Brahimi (Brest) replaces Romain Del Castillo.
82' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
81' Adi Hutter has decided to make a change. Takumi Minamino (Monaco) replaces Folarin Balogun.
81' Substitution. Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco) in, Ismail Jakobs out.
79' A defence splitting pass into the box is almost received by Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco), but Marco Bizot is quick enough and comes off his line to intercept the pass.
77' Crossbar! Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) throws the chance away as he attempts to produce a shot from inside the box, but his attempt only rattles the crossbar! The goalkeeper can remain calm.
77' Brendan Chardonnet (Brest) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
73' Eric Roy decides to make a substitution. Mahdi Camara will be replaced by Kamory Doumbia (Brest).
73' The referee signals a substitution. Martin Satriano (Brest) is brought on as a substitute for Steve Mounie.
72' CHANCE! Brendan Chardonnet (Brest) rises high to meet the resultant corner kick and attempts to steer his fine header past the goalkeeper, but only hits the left post!
72' Good work from Brest as they win a corner.
69' 2 - 0 Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) latches on to a killer pass deep inside the box and coolly puts the ball inside the right post!
67' Eric Wattellier shows a yellow card to Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) for his blatant foul.
66' Brest take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
66' A cross from Kenny Lala (Brest) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The ball goes out of play. Brest are awarded a corner kick.
65' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Maghnes Akliouche walks off the pitch to be replaced by Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco).
62' The main referee, Eric Wattellier, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) is given a yellow card for dissent.
62' Eric Wattellier shows a yellow card to Lilian Brassier (Brest), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
61' Bradley Locko (Brest) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
58' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest).
56' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) takes the corner but it's cleared.
56' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Folarin Balogun (Monaco) inside the box following a slide rule pass. Monaco earn a corner.
55' A pass from Steve Mounie (Brest) is intercepted by Philipp Kohn and the move breaks down.

53' Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
53' Brest can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
48' Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from distance, but it's blocked.
47' Mahdi Camara (Brest) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
46' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
46' Mahdi Camara (Brest) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is out of play and Brest manage to earn a corner.
46' Referee Eric Wattellier blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Ismail Jakobs (Monaco) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Marco Bizot intercepts the ball.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Monaco take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
43' Eric Roy prepares a substitution. Jeremy Le Douaron is replaced by Axel Camblan (Brest).
40' Kenny Lala (Brest) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Eric Wattellier stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
39' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) commits a foul during an attacking move.
36' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) makes a strong challenge and Eric Wattellier blows for a foul.
35' Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
33' Eric Roy isn't happy on the touchline after referee Eric Wattellier shows him a yellow card.
33' Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
32' Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
31' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) receives a clever chip pass into a promising position. Nevertheless, one of the defenders is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
28' Celebrations are cut short for Brest as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
28' The Brest players halt their celebrations as referee Eric Wattellier makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
27' Goal! Lilian Brassier (Brest) coolly slotted the ball past the goalkeeper.
26' Rough tackle by Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. Brest are awarded the free kick.
25' A goal, which was scored by Folarin Balogun (Monaco), was disallowed due to offside.
23' Looks like Brendan Chardonnet (Brest) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
23' Youssouf Fofana (Monaco) commits a rough challenge and Eric Wattellier blows his whistle for a foul.
21' The rebound finds Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) in space inside the box, but his shot flies high over the bar. That was a promising chance!
19' Brendan Chardonnet (Brest) takes a first-time shot inside the box after latching onto a nice lofted pass, but the effort is blocked and spins away to safety.

16' 1 - 0 Denis Zakaria (Monaco) outjumps the defenders inside the six-yard box to meet the corner and scores with a header into the middle of the goal. The keeper had no chance to react. The score is now 1:0.
16' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

16' Good clearance! Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him. The linesman points to the corner flag, Monaco are going to take it.
13' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal due to a foul. The Brest players look gutted.
11' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible foul. The Brest players aren’t happy.
11' It's a goal! Mahdi Camara plays a lovely pass into the box and finds Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest). He tries his luck from close range and coolly strikes the ball into the back of the net. 0:1.
10' Steve Mounie (Brest) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
8' Eric Wattellier shows the yellow card to Bradley Locko (Brest) for a heavy challenge.
7' A promising move ends with a clever pass to Denis Zakaria (Monaco), who hits a first-time shot at goal that rises just over the bar.
6' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Ismail Jakobs (Monaco), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
4' Eric Wattellier blows his whistle and it's Wilfried Singo (Monaco) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
2' The resulting corner, taken by Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco), comes to nothing.

1' Youssouf Fofana (Monaco) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The ball goes behind for a corner. Monaco will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Brest will have the kick-off.
Eric Wattellier will officiate today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
